subject: ABC sweeps — vulcan compute plan
body: Ines — compute plan for the factor-isolation sweeps. The Shapes3D experiment grid is wide (set-supervision settings × factor groupings × seeds — train.py makes this cheap to launch and expensive to run), and the pose-estimation training adds a second wave. We hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-01 — 256 GPUs — and both waves are packed into that week: the Shapes3D grid across the first three days, pose models the back two. The MINE information estimates run alongside on the same slices (they're light). Asks: (1) confirm the reservation on your books; (2) we plan to be well clear before the 06-22 to 06-24 vulcan maintenance, but if our week slips please tell us early — the end-of-June recommendation has no slack behind it. Dev runs continue on titan best-effort. — Santiago
